3. Stage 2 (this turn): made `SprintBoardModals` the single modal host by adding a kanban column picker plus New/Edit Column and New Board dialogs, then pointed `KanbanBoardView` at it for rich task creation (message, mode, project, profiles, model, files, attachments, assignees, deadline, cost budget, Add/Run).
